# Topology.KnotGauss.build_knot_n6_targeted_barrier8

Exports: `Topology.build_knot_n6_targeted_barrier8`

## `build_knot_n6_targeted_barrier8(; progress::Bool=true) -> KnotN6TargetedBarrier8Result`

    build_knot_n6_targeted_barrier8(; progress::Bool=true) -> KnotN6TargetedBarrier8Result

Return the targeted barrier-eight extension of the default six-crossing classification.

# Arguments
The data definitions and numbered conditions are in the
[specification](../../specs/knot-classification.md).

`progress` controls progress messages. The default local KnotInfo snapshot
must be readable and valid for [`build_knot_n6_classification`](build_knot_n6_classification.md).
Input, snapshot, transition-verification and consistency errors from the
classification and targeted searches propagate. This zero-argument route
requests the full six-crossing input, not the small fixture overload.

# Returns
`KnotN6TargetedBarrier8Result`: `seed_components` identifies the still
unresolved barrier-seven components, `resolved_components` and
`unresolved_components` report the resulting disposition, and
`connected_known_labels` records known labels reached. Counts describe states,
candidates, adopted/reused transitions, verification outcomes and frontier
size. `status` and `resource_reason` distinguish completion from resource
termination; fingerprints identify the input and computed closure.

# Guarantees
1. The result concerns the repository's verified local-move graph through
   eight crossings, targeted from components unresolved after barrier seven.
   It is evidence about paths in that finite graph. [proved/agent: by construction]
2. A resolved label is supported by a connection to the corresponding known
   component. Unresolved components receive no invented knot type. [proved/agent: by construction]
3. `barrier == 8`. A returned resource-limited result retains its status;
   successful return alone does not assert exhaustive closure. [proved/agent: by construction]
4. Arguments and the input snapshot are not modified. [proved/agent: by construction]

# Not guaranteed
This is not a census of all diagrams through eight crossings or a proof that
separate components represent distinct knots. Full paths and move witnesses
are not retained in the result.

# Sources
cf: lib/topology.jl/src/reidemeister.jl verify_reidemeister_transition — retained edges have local signed-Gauss transition evidence, not an unbounded equivalence decision.

# Examples
```jldoctest
julia> c = build_knot_n6_classification(3; barrier=3, progress=false);

julia> r = build_knot_n6_targeted_barrier8(c; progress=false);

julia> (isempty(r.seed_components), r.n7_state_count, r.n8_state_count, r.status)
(true, 0, 0, "barrier8_resolved_all_seed_components")
```

See also [`knot_n6_targeted_barrier8_summary`](knot_n6_targeted_barrier8_summary.md), [`run_knot_n6_targeted_barrier8`](run_knot_n6_targeted_barrier8.md).

## `build_knot_n6_targeted_barrier8(classification::KnotN6Classification; progress::Bool=true) -> KnotN6TargetedBarrier8Result`

    build_knot_n6_targeted_barrier8(classification::KnotN6Classification; progress::Bool=true) -> KnotN6TargetedBarrier8Result

Return a targeted barrier-eight extension of an existing bounded knot classification.

# Arguments
`classification` must be a coherent result of
[`build_knot_n6_classification`](build_knot_n6_classification.md) with `max_n` in `0:6`.
`progress` controls progress messages. An out-of-range `max_n` throws
`ArgumentError`; inconsistent indices, known labels, transitions or closure
data propagate the targeted-search errors. No independent validation of all
manually assembled classification fields is performed.

# Returns
`KnotN6TargetedBarrier8Result` with barrier, input fingerprints, seed and
resolved/unresolved component data, known-label connections, search and
verification counts, elapsed time, and `status`/`resource_reason` fields.
Use [`knot_n6_targeted_barrier8_summary`](knot_n6_targeted_barrier8_summary.md) for a compact view.

# Guarantees
1. The result describes finite verified-move connections extending the input's
   unresolved components through the targeted barrier-seven and barrier-eight
   searches. Its mathematical scope is that finite diagram graph. [proved/agent: by construction]
2. `barrier == 8`. Reported resolved labels come from connections to known
   input components; unresolved components are preserved as unresolved. [proved/agent: by construction]
3. The supplied classification is not modified by this operation. [proved/agent: by construction]

# Not guaranteed
This is not an eight-crossing census or an unbounded knot-equivalence
decision. Resource termination can produce a partial result; inspect
`status` and `resource_reason`. No full paths or parent arrays are returned.
The [module scope](../../specs/module-structure.md#1-構成) does not itself
certify the local-move or classical-realizability conventions.

# Sources
cf: lib/topology.jl/src/reidemeister.jl verify_reidemeister_transition — local transition evidence underlying the finite graph.

# Examples
```jldoctest
julia> c = build_knot_n6_classification(3; barrier=3, progress=false);

julia> r = build_knot_n6_targeted_barrier8(c; progress=false);

julia> (isempty(r.seed_components), r.n7_state_count, r.n8_state_count, r.status)
(true, 0, 0, "barrier8_resolved_all_seed_components")
```

See also [`knot_n6_targeted_barrier8_summary`](knot_n6_targeted_barrier8_summary.md).
